notes.title: The inspiration behind the map!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Constructors![/b][/h1]

Are you curious [b]what region inspired this map?[/b]

[previewyoutube=Kit9YCoWiXY;full][/previewyoutube]
What place is [b]surrounded by mountains[/b] and has [b]this kind of architecture?[/b]
[b]Any ideas?[/b]

We won’t keep you in the dark any longer.
[h3]This map was inspired by [b]a village in north-western Slovenia.[/b][/h3]

[b]What do you think[/b] about this map?
[h3][b]Let us know![/b][/h3]

And if you have any [b]questions[/b] or simply want to [b]stay up to date[/b] - [b]join our Discord[/b] and become a part of [b]Madnetic Games Community[/b] family

notes.title: The town is growing!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Constructors![/b][/h1]

It’s time for another update!
You’ve already seen a few [b]vehicles[/b] that you’ll get to use throughout the game. But to be able to drive them, [b]you need roads.[/b] To make them work, [b]you need buildings.[/b] In short - [b]you need a town.[/b]

And we have good news. [b]We’re already building it![/b]

[h3]Here, take a look at this [b]beautiful house[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/e0fbb3057ce6b4f2708a9231a2cdd81fd9008cf7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/606c0d3c9d0c53e648f8048292e82bd5add2747b.png[/img]

[h3]Isn’t it great? [b]Let us know[/b] what you think![/h3]

[b]Stay tuned[/b] for more! You can do that by [b]joining our Discord.[/b] Become a part of [b]Madnetic Games Community[/b] family

notes.title: Reach higher with the static crane!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Constructors![/b][/h1]

It's time for another [b]update[/b] on [b]Heavy Duty Costruction[/b].
This time instead of driving left and right, [b]we will go up[/b].

[h3]We present to you the [b]static crane[/b]![/h3]

This machine will help you with [b]bigger constructions[/b] requiring [b]reaching higher[/b] than the mobile crane allows you to and [b]lifting even heavier objects[/b].
